Name: SOUND_ASSET_SOUND_OBJ_ENABLE_DIST_PARAM_ST
Description: How close the listener must be for an asset's sounds to be loaded. The row ID is the asset's Sound Bank ID (AssetEnvironmentGeometryParam; in retail usually the asset's own model number, for example 99005 for AEG099_005, or a shared bank such as 800007). An asset whose bank has no row keeps its sounds loaded all the time.

Fields.Name: Sound Enable Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in metres from the listener within which the asset's sound bank is loaded and its sounds can play; it is released again when the listener moves away. The distance of SoundCommonIngameParam row 500 is added (retail 5 m), with row 501 as a margin either side so it doesn't switch on and off at the edge (retail 2 m). 0 or less: always loaded. Retail 8–320 m.
